translation: AI-assisted translation (Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15). Index-relative entries are DEFERRED (owner priority change: no ETF-for-index substitution); they originally used ETF PROXIES that exist as local candles: Nifty 50 -> NIFTYBEES-EQ, Nifty Bank -> BANKBEES-EQ, Nifty IT -> ITBEES-EQ (tracking error and ETF fees apply; recorded as APPROXIMATION). Cross-sectional 'top decile of the universe' rules are translated as time-series thresholds (APPROXIMATION) because no point-in-time universe exists. F&O, options, VIX, institutional-flow and delivery rules are BLOCKED with the exact data requirement.

strategies.name: Alpha Rotation (Composite Momentum)
assumptions: time-series threshold replaces the cross-sectional >= 90th percentile rank of NSE 500 (no point-in-time universe)
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (rare): TOO RARE; daily trades 5 mean net 3.917%; intraday trades - mean net -%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Amihud Illiquidity Drop
strategies.entry: sma(abs(ret) / (close * volume), 20) < 0.5 * sma(sma(abs(ret) / (close * volume), 20), 100) and close > sma(close, 50)
assumptions: traded value approximated by close x volume; long direction requires close > SMA50 (the catalogue gives a trigger without direction)
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (rare): TOO RARE; daily trades 14 mean net -0.043%; intraday trades - mean net -%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: PEAD Technical Proxy
strategies.entry: any_of(gap > 0.04 and volume > 3 * sma(volume, 20), 10) and low <= ema(close, 10) and close > ema(close, 10)
assumptions: results day proxied by a >4% gap on 3x volume (no announcement dates)
